improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: Steady at about 55% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Shot selection
tips: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
improve.coach: 36% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: That's what I call neighborly football. 64% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: Fortune favors the folks who shoot. There in 64% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it. 45% of the time. Teammates can count on it.
